posts.title: Morocco (where the mules have no names)
posts.description: Last week I travelled to Morocco – a journey that was a first for me in many ways. It was my first time out of my comfort zone of travelling to European or English-speaking countries, my first time on the African continent, my first time in an Islamic country and my first time on a multi-day organized hike. posts.title: Broadway Binge
posts.description: I recently spent 2 weeks in New York City to feed my nostalgia and revisit this place that I kind of grew up with. I used to stay with a relative here on my past visits, who sadly passed away a few years ago. But what I did a few times with her was to go to TKTS and get discounted same-day tickets for a show.
